item.text: {"cost_regression":false,"evidence":[{"citation":"“Compare the checkout with its documented pre-run state, including staged, unstaged, and untracked files”; “Verify that all pre-existing work remains byte-for-byte or diff-for-diff unchanged and sweep the live checkout for remaining run artifacts”; and “Rerun the case in a disposable isolated checkout with a fresh, context-free runner.”","criterion":"C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.","status":"necessary"}],"rationale":"The required work establishes run validity, safely restores only attributable changes, protects unrelated checkout state, checks for leakage, and produces an uncontaminated reproducible rerun. These are necessary integrity, isolation, provenance, and reproducibility controls under the supplied bar."}
